messages.subject: Bearing bracket HN (part:310020) – revised packages for 2027
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for agreeing to the 1500 ppm target. That is an important step in the improvement plan we asked for in our letter of 21 September.

The forecast for part:310020 increased by 20% (fc:310020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

The higher volume gives your foundry steadier loading over the full 12-month term. That should help your planning and cash flow without any extra effort in sales.

We attach two complete packages. The second gives you a stricter quality target in exchange for a slightly different price. Could you also tell us whether a cheaper process or material variant would meet the drawing?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
